stratification: StratifiedKFold / stratified train-test split used everywhere.
decision: Training split is only mildly imbalanced (1.18:1, minority 45.9%). SMOTE was evaluated inside the CV folds (never on the whole dataset) and is reported above; it is not used in the final model because it did not improve cross-validated ROC-AUC over stratified sampling, and synthesising patients adds risk without solving a problem this dataset has. Class weighting remains a tunable option in every model's search grid.
